name: djl
description_en: An Engine-Agnostic Deep Learning Framework in Java
readme_excerpt: Deep Java Library (DJL) Overview Deep Java Library (DJL) is an open-source, high-level, engine-agnostic Java framework for deep learning. DJL is designed to be easy to get started with and simple to use for Java developers. DJL provides a native Java development experience and functions like any other regular Java library.
